exposure: mechanism of injury (assault, falls, motor vehicle accidents)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 800 pregnant trauma patients admitted to Chris Hani Baragwanath Academic Hospital over a 5-year period.
finding: Assaults, falls, and motor vehicle accidents were the most common causes of maternal trauma, and pregnant patients who were single and unemployed were at increased risk of obstetric trauma.
gest_age: Median gestational age of mothers at admission was 26.00 weeks, and 11 neonates were delivered before 37 weeks.
